blocks.orig: When you’re out and about exploring, you want to come back to a cosy and welcoming lodge in Arusha. And lucky you: there are plenty of wow hotels which will become your home away from home. Here you can enjoy comfort, taste local delicacies, and recharge your batteries before embarking on your next adventure.
blocks.html: After a day of exploring, you want to return to a warm and welcoming lodge in Arusha. Happily, there is no shortage of impressive hotels that will quickly feel like a second home. Here you can settle into comfort, sample local dishes and recharge before you head off on your next adventure.

blocks.orig: We have put together ten of the most scenic accommodations in Arusha, so that you only have to one thing: pick your favourite and start dreaming!
blocks.html: We have selected ten of the most beautifully located places to stay in Arusha, which leaves you with just one job: choose your favourite and start dreaming!

blocks.orig: Situated among tea and coffee plantations, Gran Meliá is a modern and beautiful lodge in Arusha. From its terrace and lounge, it offers a clear view of Mount Meru and the city. And should you prefer some privacy, simply sip your favourite drink on your private balcony.
blocks.html: Set among tea and coffee plantations, Gran Meliá is a modern, attractive lodge in Arusha. Its terrace and lounge look straight out over Mount Meru and the city, and if you would rather have some privacy, you can enjoy your favourite drink on your own balcony.

blocks.orig: After a strenuous hike or exciting safari, this superb Arusha accommodation pampers you with amenities to help you relax. Kick back in the hotel spa, jump into the heated pool, or simply take a stroll through the stunning gardens with national park vibes.
blocks.html: After a demanding hike or an exciting safari, this excellent Arusha hotel spoils you with everything you need to unwind. Relax in the spa, dive into the heated pool or wander through the lovely gardens, which feel almost like a national park.

blocks.orig: Legendary Lodge in Arusha is also surrounded by a beautiful coffee plantation, and it’s safe to say that this accommodation is the definition of African authenticity. Far from the buzzing tourist hotspots, it offers a peaceful yet luxurious retreat. Here you can enjoy a mix of privacy, comfort and majestic mountain views.
blocks.html: Legendary Lodge in Arusha is likewise set within a beautiful coffee plantation, and it is fair to say this place embodies African authenticity. Well away from the busy tourist spots, it provides a calm yet luxurious hideaway where privacy, comfort and grand mountain views come together.

blocks.orig: The lodge is a great place to embark on your safari and to do other activities like canoeing, birdwatching and hiking. At this cosy place you can come close to the wildlife and unite with nature.
blocks.html: The lodge makes an excellent base for starting your safari and for other activities such as canoeing, birdwatching and hiking. In this cosy setting you get close to the wildlife and feel at one with nature.

blocks.orig: The Safari House is a 10-bedroom boutique hotel with contemporary features, an outside pool, spacious rooms, and delicious food. No matter if you want to get on Tanzania time, recover before your next adventure, play golf or ride a horse – here you can do it all in style.
blocks.html: The Safari House is a boutique hotel with 10 bedrooms, contemporary touches, an outdoor pool, roomy bedrooms and excellent food. Whether you want to ease into Tanzanian time, recover before the next leg of your trip, play a round of golf or go horse riding, you can do it all here with style.

blocks.orig: This Arusha lodge is ideal for couples and families as the rooms have private bathrooms and some even a kitchenette. Taking a stroll around the estate will make your eyes sparkle, since African wildlife like zebras and elands lives nearby.
blocks.html: With private bathrooms in every room, and a kitchenette in some, this Arusha lodge suits couples and families alike. A walk around the estate is a treat for the eyes, as African wildlife such as zebras and elands lives close by.

blocks.orig: Surrounded by coffee plantations, the charming Lake Duluti Lodge offers an oasis of peace and tranquillity. Enjoy a refreshing drink on the porch, take in the unmatched beauty around you, and gather strength for your next trip.
blocks.html: Tucked between coffee plantations, the delightful Lake Duluti Lodge is a haven of peace and calm. Sip a cool drink on the veranda, soak up the extraordinary beauty around you and build up energy for the next stage of your journey.

blocks.orig: The 19 spacious rooms have private bathrooms and scenic views all around. The best part of staying here is dining at the lake shore – a perfect opportunity to spend time and cherish every second with your loved ones.
blocks.html: Its 19 generous rooms all have private bathrooms and lovely views in every direction. The highlight of a stay here is dinner at the lakeside, the perfect chance to slow down and savour every moment with the people you love.

blocks.orig: Ahadi Lodge is situated right in the heart of Arusha, comprises five individual cottages and enchants with lush gardens. After a long flight or a safari in Arusha National Park, the pool is the place to be. Take the plunge and enjoy first-class and authentic African cuisine in the cosy restaurant afterwards.
blocks.html: Located right in the centre of Arusha, Ahadi Lodge consists of five separate cottages and charms with its lush gardens. After a long flight or a safari in Arusha National Park, the pool is where you want to be. Take a dip, then enjoy first-rate, authentic African cooking in the cosy restaurant.

blocks.orig: Siringit Villa is anything but hustle and bustle. Away from the noises of a busy city, you can enjoy silence and nature at its best  – and listen to some birds singing. This 6-bedroom villa unites impeccable service with great food and an unparalleled scenery. The perfect place to charge your batteries for the next highlight of your Tanzania holiday.
blocks.html: Siringit Villa is the opposite of hustle and bustle. Far from the noise of the busy city, you can enjoy stillness and nature at its finest, with birdsong as the soundtrack. This villa with 6 bedrooms combines flawless service with wonderful food and unrivalled scenery. It is the ideal spot to recharge before the next highlight of your Tanzania holiday.

blocks.orig: Another luxurious accommodation is Arusha Planet Lodge. The idyllic resort offers great food, outstanding service, and spacious rooms with comfortable beds. It is conveniently located near the Kilimanjaro Airport, and the palm and banana trees create a secluded oasis many travellers have fallen in love with.
blocks.html: Arusha Planet Lodge is another luxurious option. This idyllic resort serves excellent food, provides outstanding service and has spacious rooms with comfortable beds. It lies conveniently close to Kilimanjaro Airport, and its palm and banana trees create a secluded oasis that many travellers have grown to love.

blocks.orig: If you want to get far away from the city, Ngare Sero Mountain Lodge is meant for you. Here you can experience African wildlife up close and treat yourself to food cooked from the lodge’s own garden. From walking in the area to taking a boat in the lagoon or simply marvel at Mount Kilimanjaro – we promise you that you won’t get bored here.
blocks.html: If you would rather be well away from the city, Ngare Sero Mountain Lodge is the place for you. Here you see African wildlife at close range and eat food grown in the lodge’s own garden. Walks in the surroundings, a boat trip on the lagoon or simply gazing at Mount Kilimanjaro: we promise you will never be bored here.

blocks.orig: Arusha Villa welcomes travellers who seek peace, but don’t want to miss out on memorable experiences. Recharge on a sunbed at the pool, take a stroll in the lush garden, visit villages with a guide and observe Blue Monkeys playing in the trees. The cherry on the cake? Delicious meals, great views of Mount Meru and a good night’s sleep in a comfy bed.
blocks.html: Arusha Villa is made for travellers who want peace and quiet without missing out on memorable experiences. Unwind on a sunbed by the pool, wander through the lush garden, visit nearby villages with a guide and watch Blue Monkeys at play in the trees. The icing on the cake? Delicious food, fine views of Mount Meru and a restful night in a comfortable bed.

blocks.orig: If you love animals and want to stay at an authentic lodge in Arusha, head over to the Wildlife Residence. This accommodation is timeless and wows you with breathtaking views of Mount Meru and Kilimanjaro. The highlight: breakfast by the pool, where wild animals tend to graze. So while you’re sipping your morning coffee, wildebeests, elands, kudus, zebras and Co. are having their breakfast right in front of you.
blocks.html: Animal lovers looking for an authentic lodge in Arusha should head to the Wildlife Residence. This timeless place impresses with stunning views of Mount Meru and Kilimanjaro. The highlight is breakfast beside the pool, where wild animals often come to graze. As you drink your morning coffee, wildebeest, elands, kudus, zebras and their friends are eating their breakfast right in front of you.

blocks.orig: And that’s a wrap! From cosy and authentic, to contemporary and secluded – find the lodge in Arusha that perfectly matches your Tanzania plans. And if you need a little help, we’re here for you.
blocks.html: And there you have it! Cosy and authentic or contemporary and secluded: find the lodge in Arusha that fits your Tanzania plans best. Should you want a bit of help, we’re happy to assist.
